design: field orientation manipulation + supplemental pollination + watering + visitor choice + pollen germination
fitness_or_process_endpoint: seed set; pollen germination; visitor preference
quantitative_note: natural-species orientation matched seed-set optima; pollinator-mediated selection undetectable; rain reduces pollen germination
claim_boundary: Strong independent orientation system, but species-specific morphology modifies rain entry; extract treatments separately.

design: three floral orientations; rain and pollination observations
causal_chain: orientation -> rain retention/pollination precision -> pollen transfer
quantitative_note: horizontal orientation reduced rain exposure relative to upward and improved hawkmoth visitation/pollen load
claim_boundary: Process study; do not invent seed-fitness effect if not reported.

causal_chain: orientation -> pollination + rain damage avoidance -> female pollination success
fitness_or_process_endpoint: visits; stigmatic pollen; pollen bursting; female success
quantitative_note: horizontal flowers improved visitation/pollen transfer and avoided rain damage; ~30% pollen burst in distilled water
claim_boundary: Extract exact treatment contrasts from primary tables before meta use.

design: downward control vs artificially upward flowers; visitor/effective-transfer + sun/rain exposure
causal_chain: orientation -> pollinator filtering + abiotic protection -> reproductive fitness
fitness_or_process_endpoint: visitation; pollen transfer; pollen viability; stigma receptivity; seed number/set; fruit traits
quantitative_note: downward orientation improved effective bumblebee service and abiotic protection; seed number and seed set per fruit higher
claim_boundary: "New 2026 independent direct causal system; use direct effect extraction

design: natural nodding vs experimentally erect plus pollinator/UV/water tests
causal_chain: orientation -> abiotic protection/pollinator pathway -> achene fitness
fitness_or_process_endpoint: achene set; pollen viability; pollinator preference
quantitative_note: current EAzami target RR for achene set = 3.58599; static pollinator preference null
claim_boundary: Retain as existing anchor; do not double-count with orientation target registry.

design: natural polymorphism + MeOH removal of floral stickiness
causal_chain: floral stickiness -> florivore exclusion -> fruit fitness
quantitative_note: washed sticky inflorescences had ~21% herbivore attack and 32.5% lower fruit set than sticky controls
claim_boundary: Direct floral manipulation strongly relevant; population interaction/context dependence must be retained.

design: genetically based glandular vs nonglandular trichome morphs under herbivore exposure/protection
causal_chain: glandular stickiness/resistance -> herbivory + allocation cost -> viable seed fitness
quantitative_note: herbivore-free sticky/glandular plants produced ~45% fewer viable seeds; net benefit under herbivory not established in first-year test
claim_boundary: Vegetative glandular-trichome resistance analog, not floral stickiness; keep separate moderator/class.

quantitative_note: direct neutralization null for generic reproductive-defence prediction
claim_boundary: Existing Cirsium negative-control anchor; no adaptive defence claim.

design: comparative pollination/defence trait study with structural accessibility index
causal_chain: spines/structural defence -> floral accessibility -> pollination/florivory context
quantitative_note: spinescence contributes to an inflorescence accessibility index
claim_boundary: Comparative covariance, not direct manipulation; useful hypothesis/evolutionary-context evidence only.

design: phylogenetically controlled comparative flower-head trait/florivory study
quantitative_note: larger diameter and more flower heads tended to receive more florivory; biochemical traits also mattered
claim_boundary: Very relevant Asteraceae functional context, but not direct phyllary/spine manipulation and no causal fitness effect.

design: water treatment plus anthocyanin flower-colour variation
causal_chain: pigmentation x water regime -> fecundity; herbivore colour choice
quantitative_note: colour x water interaction: increasing pigmentation reduced fitness in well-watered control but not under drought; herbivores consumed more white petals
claim_boundary: Important counterexample to a universal pigmented-under-drought advantage; extract genotype/phenotype structure carefully.

design: chalcone synthase null vs pigmented genotype under temperature/light stress
causal_chain: flavonoid pigmentation x heat -> fertilization success
quantitative_note: nonpigmented aa showed larger male/female fertilization loss at high temperature than AA
claim_boundary: Direct genetic/abiotic functional test; distinguish flavonoid pathway effect from visual pollinator colour effect.

causal_chain: flower-colour morph x precipitation regime -> seed fitness
quantitative_note: selection switched direction among years; blue often advantaged in low spring precipitation and white in wetter years; coefficients up to ~0.60
claim_boundary: Key time-varying selection study; observational climate-selection link, mechanism unresolved.

design: population climate comparison + supplemental UV treatment
causal_chain: UV/climate -> anthocyanin/UV floral pattern -> pollen performance
fitness_or_process_endpoint: anthocyanin concentration; UV reflectance; pollen performance
quantitative_note: supplemental UV affected anthocyanin concentration; climate covaried with pigmentation and flower size
claim_boundary: Mechanism/process study; separate plastic response from evolutionary selection.

taxon_or_scope: 12 North American species; >1900 herbarium records; 124 years
quantitative_note: pigmentation declined with temperature and increased with VPD/aridity across taxa
claim_boundary: Temporal macro-context, not direct trait->fitness effect; use for FDT2/FDT6 context rather than FDT1 causal pool.
